name: Anomaly Detection
summary: Finding rare, unusual observations such as fraud, faults and intrusions with statistical, distance-, density-, isolation- and deep-learning-based detectors.

topics.name: Types of anomalies (point, contextual, collective) and problem settings
Statistical methods: z-scores, robust statistics, extreme value theory
Distance- and density-based methods: kNN and Local Outlier Factor
One-class methods: One-class SVM, SVDD and Deep SVDD
Visual anomaly detection for industrial inspection
Evaluation with rare labels: PR-AUC, precision at k
Applications: fraud, intrusion detection, predictive maintenance
Alert triage, human-in-the-loop feedback and drift
